description: Verified reference data for AI agents. Every figure carries an official source URL and a verifiedDate — built for the questions agents misquote from memory. No auth, CORS-open. Country-prefixed: /api/uk/*; more countries later.

GET /.well-known/changes.json.description: Protocol discovery document: areas tracked, cadence, endpoints (json/html/rss/atom/mcp), schema URL, licence, contact.

GET /api/changes.description: What changed in the verified datasets since a date (REST mirror of what_changed_since). format=html|rss|atom serves the /changes page or feeds instead of JSON.

params.area: uk-rates | uk-exams | vehicles | software-eol | policy-rates | all

GET /api/policy-rates.description: Central-bank policy rates, verified 2026-10-03 against the banks' own pages: Bank of England Bank Rate, US Federal Reserve federal funds target range (lower/upper bound), ECB deposit facility, main refinancing and marginal lending rates — each with effectiveFrom, decisionDate and meeting, previous level, latest decision, next scheduled decision and the decision press release. Committed data (not a live proxy), re-verified within 45 days and after each decision.

GET /api/provenance/domain.description: Who runs this domain? Live RDAP: age, registrar, nameservers, typosquat resemblance. Descriptive signals, not a verdict.

GET /api/provenance/package.description: Who publishes this package, and is it a typosquat? Live npm/PyPI metadata.

GET /api/software-eol/status.description: Is this version still supported, and until when? nodejs, python, ubuntu, debian, android, ios, macos, windows, oracle-jdk, go, ruby, php, postgresql, react — a monthly snapshot of endoflife.date open data (MIT; 340 release cycles, verified 2026-10-03). A version resolves to its release cycle ("18.19.0" → 18, "3.11.4" → 3.11, "22.04.3" → 22.04, "bookworm" → 12); returns supported true|false as of today, eol date, days remaining or since, active/extended-support ends, LTS, latest release, the newest supported cycle, a plain-statement recommendation and the endoflife.date page as source.

params.product: one of nodejs, python, ubuntu, debian, android, ios, macos, windows, oracle-jdk, go, ruby, php, postgresql, react (aliases: node, java, jdk, postgres, golang, osx, win)

GET /api/software-eol/timeline.description: Every release cycle of a product, newest first, with release date, supported true|false, eol, LTS, latest release and support-end dates; same snapshot as /status.

params.product: one of nodejs, python, ubuntu, debian, android, ios, macos, windows, oracle-jdk, go, ruby, php, postgresql, react

GET /api/tax/take-home.description: Take-home pay after income tax and social contributions for uk, us, ca, au, in, br, pl, fr, de, es: gross, net and total deductions (annual + monthly), typed breakdown, effectiveRate, taxYear, currency, assumptions. Live proxy to the LifeByNumbers salary calculators (same operator). Spain (es) returns covered:false — no backend calculator.

params.country: uk | us | ca | au | in | br | pl | fr | de | es
params.gross: salary in local currency (annual unless period=monthly)

GET /api/uk/exams/papers.description: Past-paper index: official assessment-resources links per spec (links only — papers are board copyright).

GET /api/uk/exams/specs.description: Spec metadata: codes, paper structure, durations, tiers, official links.

GET /api/uk/exams/topic.description: Which paper is a topic on? Built for queries like "is electricity paper 2 AQA".

GET /api/uk/rates.description: UK tax-year rates & thresholds (2026-27), verified against gov.uk.

params.category: one of income-tax, national-insurance, minimum-wage, student-loans, vat, isa, state-pension, stamp-duty, capital-gains, pensions (omit to list)

endpoints.GET /api/vehicles/eu/safety-gate: STUB — EU Safety Gate vehicle alerts are being added; returns covered:false with the official URL for now.

GET /api/vehicles/fr/recalls.description: Official French vehicle recalls (RappelConso / DGCCRF open data, 1663 automobile fiches 2018-01-19 → 2026-08-07) for a brand (+ model): fiche number, date, risks, defect text, official fiche link.

GET /api/vehicles/fr/search.description: Keyword search across all RappelConso automobile fiches (French text), newest first, optional since date.

GET /api/vehicles/jp/complaints.description: MLIT owner defect reports (19659 across 75 models): total per model + breakdown by defective device.

GET /api/vehicles/jp/recalls.description: Official Japanese recall filings (国土交通省 MLIT; 919 filings across 75 popular JDM models): notification number, date, device, affected vehicles, situation/remedy, official PDF. English or Japanese names.

GET /api/vehicles/uk/mot.description: Real UK MOT failure data for one model generation: per-category failure rates (overall and at your mileage), riskiest components. Live proxy to whatbreaks.uk (same operator; DfT anonymised MOT results).

GET /api/vehicles/uk/recalls.description: Official UK vehicle safety recalls (DVSA open data, OGL v3.0; 4876 recalls launched 2016-01-01 → 2027-02-03) for a make (+ model): recall number, launch date, concern, defect and remedy text, build-date range, vehicles affected, GOV.UK recall-checker link.

params.model: optional, e.g. Corsa (omit to list the make and its model names)

GET /api/vehicles/uk/recalls-search.description: Keyword search across all served DVSA recalls (English text: make, model, concern, defect, remedy), newest first, optional since date.

GET /api/vehicles/uk/search.description: Search the 530 UK model generations covered by the MOT dataset (live proxy to whatbreaks.uk).

GET /changes.description: The changelog as a page: every verified change to UK tax/NI thresholds, exam specs, official vehicle datasets, software end-of-life dates and central-bank policy rates, newest first by month — area, from → to, effectiveFrom, official source, maintainer note, verifiedDate. Indexable, cached 1 h at the edge.

params.area: optional: uk-rates | uk-exams | vehicles | software-eol | policy-rates

GET /changes.atom.description: Atom feed of the changelog (?area= optional); same entries as /changes.rss.

GET /changes.rss.description: RSS 2.0 feed of the changelog (?area= optional). guid = permalink on /changes, link = official source, pubDate = verifiedDate.

GET /protocol.description: The Verified Changes protocol v0.1 specification — the open convention /api/changes, /changes, the feeds and what_changed_since follow, so any site can publish dated, sourced from/to entries and any assistant can consume them. Indexable HTML; ?format=md returns the markdown.

GET /r/<route>?….description: Citation permalinks (human-readable answer + official source + verified date). Every API/MCP result includes one as cite.url.

GET /schema/changes.v0.json.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for a changes document and a single entry; /schema/well-known-changes.v0.json covers the discovery document.

GET|POST /api/stats.description: Exact statistics & probability — for the maths agents get wrong in their head. ?op= one of: descriptive, distribution, hypothesis-test, confidence-interval, bayes-update, regression. Array/table inputs via POST JSON body. Numerical core validated against reference tables.

POST /api/mcp.description: THE FRONT DOOR — one remote MCP server for the whole estate. Lists uk_rates_lookup, exam_topic_paper, domain_provenance, package_provenance, take_home_pay directly, plus what_changed_since (changes since your training cutoff), coverage, catalogue and call (run any tool by name). Every result carries freshness + a cite.url permalink.
POST /api/mcp.example: add https://databutler.dev/api/mcp to any MCP client
